scientific_contract_findings.finding: Uncertain answers are counted separately but excluded from the binary confusion-matrix denominators. Sensitivity, specificity, PPV and NPV are therefore conditional on non-abstaining answers and can rise when a reader abstains on hard cases. Reports must include coverage/abstention and either treat uncertainty under a predefined policy or present selective-classification metrics, not unconditional diagnostic performance.

Public registration assigns doctor role and accepts self-reported hospital, physician title and license years without credential verification. Performance summaries cannot be interpreted as licensed-physician or center-comparative evidence without verified eligibility, protocol, sampling and analysis plans.

FNA ground truth is imported from seven local center CSV labels 0/1 and stored with original source-center/path notes, but no pathology adjudication protocol, label version, inclusion/exclusion criteria or patient-level independence manifest is committed. AUC can therefore be reproduced mathematically from entered labels, not scientifically validated as diagnostic truth.

security_privacy_findings.finding: Cold-start restoration downloads SEED_ARCHIVE_URL through an os.system shell command without quoting, digest/signature or trusted-host policy. safe_extract validates member names but not symlink/hardlink targets before extractall. A malicious URL/config/archive can execute shell metacharacters or write outside the data volume and replace medical images/data.

Login/register have no rate limit, lockout or abuse control; minimum password length is six. Production blocks a newly created default admin, but an existing admin record is accepted without checking whether it still uses the documented admin123456 default. A development/restored DB promoted to production can retain known admin credentials.

The database stores physician display name, hospital, title, career stage, license years, answers/notes/timing and source-center/path metadata alongside medical images. Admin CSV exports all fields. No consent, de-identification, retention, deletion/export policy, audit-log access control, breach handling or privacy notice is present.

Open PR #1 logs into production with admin credentials, persists a session cookie jar and downloads complete answer/user exports to .tmp before copying snapshots into an artifacts directory. Files include usernames, physician metadata, answers, ground truth, source paths and submission times. It lacks encryption, restrictive chmod, retention/deletion and de-identification controls and must not be merged as-is.

Uploads cap compressed bytes at 20 MB and call PIL verify, but impose no decoded pixel limit. Decompression-bomb images can exhaust memory; formats preserved without recompression can retain embedded metadata. Medical-image ingestion requires pixel bounds and explicit metadata stripping/de-identification.
